name: logsum
about: A small log summarizer that counts entries by level and lists the most common errors.
change: Add a severity_score function that weights each level (ERROR 10, WARN 3, INFO 1, DEBUG 0), and make the report end with a line starting "Severity score:" showing the total.
upstream: logsum 2.0: typed levels, hourly buckets, --min-level filter
wanted: Report lines that help spot trouble faster are welcome.
fix: End the report with a line starting "Error rate:" that shows errors as a whole-number percentage of parsed entries.
sample:
2026-10-27T09:58:12 INFO started
2026-10-27T10:00:02 ERROR disk full
2026-10-27T10:04:40 WARN slow query
2026-10-27T10:12:09 ERROR disk full
2026-10-27T11:01:33 ERROR timeout
2026-10-27T11:02:00 DEBUG cache warm
2026-10-27T11:07:51 INFO done
